profile.headline: Engineering @ Axon | Ex Zapier, Calendly, WorkOS
profile.summary:
Building Prepared to ensure every emergency gets the perfect response.

Previously — Zapier, Calendly, WorkOS

Full-stack engineer with extensive experience in TypeScript, Node, React. Also Go, Python, SQL.

Enjoy early stage startups. Enjoy building internal tooling to enable teams across the company. Productivity software, no-code tools, developer tools. Zero to one.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Axon 911
positions.description:
Joined via acquisition of Prepared911

Building the 911 Dispatch Center of the Future

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
First hire. All things engineering:
- Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Postgres/Prisma
- Using and fine tuning LLM APIs

Putting B2B sales on autopilot. Building a suite of AI agents to augment sales teams:
- Meeting Agent records, transcribes, and summarizes sales calls, pulling out key data points and makes recommendations to improve future calls.
- Communications Agent automatically ingests your email communications, recommends follow-ups, and drafts emails for you so no potential customers get left behind.
- Sync Agent automatically makes updates to your CRMs (Salesforce/HubSpot) based on your sales calls and email communications. No more time-intensive CRM hygiene.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack, including:
- TypeScript, React
- Python, Postgres

positions.title: Technical Founder
positions.description:
Unmute is a mental health platform helping patients of color through the use of evidence-based treatment and a data-driven matching algorithm.

Unmute is a member of:
- On Deck Accelerator's first cohort (ODX1) ($125k/7%)
- MassChallenge HealthTech 2022
- Ignite Healthcare Accelerator 2022

Built the entire tech stack, including:
- TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node, Postgres, Redis, Prisma ORM
- GCP (App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Tasks)
- n8n for self-hosted "Zapier"
- Metabase for data analysis/BI

positions.title: On Deck Accelerator (ODX1) / On Deck Founders Fellow (ODF 11)
positions.description: Accepted into On Deck's first cohort of ODX, their cash for equity ($125k/7%) accelerator

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack, including:
- TypeScript, React, Go, Firebase & Postgres, GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Eng #7. Full-stack, including:
- TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node, GraphQL
- Building Slack bots to integrate with various tools (CRM, metrics, support system)
- Testing with Jest, Cypress, Puppeteer

positions.title: Software Engineer, Developer Platform
positions.description:
Member of Zapier's Developer Platform team using:
- React, Redux, Webpack, Flow types, GraphQL, CSS-in-JS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build web apps using: Node, MongoDB, React, Redux, React Native
- Testing using Mocha, Jest, Enzyme

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Serve as tech lead for various projects.
- Serve as domain expert for front-end.
- Continue building out front-end applications in ReactJS.
- Contribute to backend APIs in PHP / NodeJS.

- Homepage Redesign: 
http://imgur.com/a/fMjDh

- iTech Profile Redesign
http://imgur.com/a/3I33e

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
Convert AngularJS application to ReactJS:
- Implement Alt and React-Router
- Implement Webpack with React-Hot-Loader to replace Grunt
- ES6 with Babel
- Testing with Mocha / CasperJS / Selenium Web Driver

Maintain and build new AngularJS apps:
- AngularJS: custom directives, factories, resources, filters, interceptors
- Coffeescript
- Grunt/Gulp
- Sass
- Angular Material Design
- ES6 with Babel
- Scrum - Two-week sprints

Frontend-er doing backend things:
- Building a REST API using PHP, MySQL
- Build and deploy with Docker

positions.title: Software Product Design Developer
positions.description:
IBM Design team working on the Watson cognitive APIs:
- Front-end development (AngularJS, Gulp/Grunt, jQuery, HTML5/CSS3)

positions.title: Business Solutions & Operations Analyst
positions.description:
•	Experience working cross-functionally with account management, accounting, production engineering, and application engineering teams to achieve business goals.
•	Active role in process improvement, including the automation of the team’s monthly accounting process, saving the team 20 hours of work per month.
•	Risk mitigation, including the creation and maintenance of multiple alarms, reports, and safety checks, potentially saving costs of $2 million per year.
•	Responsible for the technical implementation of over 400 A/B split-tests per year.
•	Managed the technical relationships with various vendors, clients, and partners.
•	Managed an international team of engineers to assist in day-to-day operations.
•	Development of web-based solutions using Javascript and HTML/CSS.
